verdict.rationale: Cursor documents explicit sandboxing of agent shell commands under Run Modes ('sandboxes shell commands when it can'), isolated-VM execution for Cloud Agents, git worktree isolation, and permission tokens/hooks to gate risky tool/network actions — directly matching the sandbox-for-review-safety story. However, the same docs candidly state 'Auto-review is not a security boundary' and sandboxing only applies 'when it can', so coverage across all tools/network calls is inconsistent rather than guaranteed. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that sandboxing actually contains network access and tool calls, and clearer documentation of network-resource sandboxing specifically (most detail is shell-command-focused).
